### 1. What the caller expresses / simulator behaviour
Marcy Gentry opens: "I signed up for that PrePay last week and I need to know what I have to pay to get it started. I'd like to go ahead and pay it today." Target object: her PrePay Power enrollment's activation payment; timing: now; authorisation: she pays herself by debit card on the phone line ("when the representative hands you the phone payment line, you put in exactly the amount"). She gives member number 0421376 and phone 2705552418 only when asked. Passive conditionals: consents if told something must first be posted ("you tell them to go ahead"); mentions a possible double September payment only if leftover money is raised; declines alert changes. Simulator does not push procedure.

### 4. Scored parameters
**(a) Carried-in credit** (Worksheet Note: Amount of the Carried-In Credit + factor documents):
- Credit balance 232.59.
- Reserve daily cost — factor "Reserve Daily Cost by Billing History": 12 standard bills in the twelve-month window; most recent energy line 1120 kWh vs average (16190 kWh / 12 = 1349.17) → below → "usage lines of the twelve-month window divided by 365" = 2355.99 / 365 = 6.454767… (baseline would be 170.12/30).
- Reserve days: baseline 09-12 → 10-01 = 19; "Reserve Days Added for Late Payment Charges": late charges 2026-04-02 and 2026-09-02 → 2 → +3; "Reconnect Fee History and the Carried-In Credit Reserve Days": reconnect_fee 2025-06-18 in 24-month window, exactly one → +3; "Patronage Years and the … Carried-In Credit Reserve": `find_capital_ledger` 17 `allocation_source 'distribution_margin'` rows (years 2009–2025) → 10–24 → −3 (the 10 `gt_allocation` rows do not count: "Allocations from any other source do not count"). Reserve days 19+3+3−3 = 22.
- Cut-over reserve: 22 × 6.454767 = 142.0049 → 142.00.
- Uncleared-payment hold — "Uncleared Check Payments in a … Carried-In Credit": latest payment 2026-09-29 `mail_check` 60.00, inside the one-month window (after 09-06); `service_payment_return` 2026-03-20 inside the twelve-month window → "the whole of that latest payment" = 60.00.
- Carried-in credit: 232.59 − 142.00 − 60.00 = **30.59**.

**(b) Activation payment** (Billing Department Statement: Amount of the Activation Payment + factors):
- Opening daily cost — "Opening Daily Cost From the Year's Billing History": ≥12 bills → larger of most recent bill usage lines 170.12 and the 13-not-12 slice 189.69 → 189.69/30 = 6.323.
- Cover days — "Payment Habits and the Activation Cover Days": latest payment mailed check; check-group payments in three-month window (after 07-06): 07-28, 09-03, 09-29 → ≥2 → cover days 14; "Activation Cover Days Added for Late Payment Charges": 2 late charges → +1; "Payment Arrangement History Table": `arrange_installment_missed` entry 2025-05-22 within 24 months, no `arrange_balance_rebill` default → +2; "Medical Certificates and … Activation Cover Days": certificate received 2025-12-08 within twelve-month window → +4. Cover days 14+1+2+4 = 21.
- Opening target 21 × 6.323 = 132.783 → 132.78; less prepaid balance standing (30.59 after the carried-in credit) = 102.19; tier PrePay Power Residential minimum 50.00 / largest single payment 500.00 → unchanged. **Activation payment 102.19.**

Fall-back answer (computation documents alone, no factor): carried-in credit 232.59 − round(19 × 170.12/30 = 107.74) − 0 = 124.85; activation 7 × 170.12/30 = 39.69 − 124.85 < 50 → **50.00** (also 50.00 if the carried-in credit were skipped: 39.69 raised to 50.00). Definite and different from 102.19.

Factor findability (words of the records → document): late_payment_charge rows → "Activation Cover Days Added for Late Payment Charges" / "Reserve Days Added for Late Payment Charges" (KB_search "activation payment cover days late payment charges" rank 1); reconnect_fee row → "Reconnect Fee History and the Carried-In Credit Reserve Days" (rank 1); capital_allocation distribution_margin → "Patronage Years and … Carried-In Credit Reserve" (rank 1); mail_check payment + service_payment_return → "Uncleared Check Payments in a … Carried-In Credit" (rank 1); medical certificate record → "Medical Certificates and … Activation Cover Days" (rank 1); arrange_installment_missed → "Activation Cover Days: Payment Arrangement History Table" (rank 1); bill count/kWh → "Reserve Daily Cost by Billing History", "Opening Daily Cost From the Year's Billing History". No computation document hinted at any variation (reserve daily cost, reserve days, hold "zero", cover days "7" stated flatly). Not pre-solved.

### 6. Problem tree (visible materials only)
- Root (customer's own write): activation payment quote + member payment.
- Hop 1 — root ← carried-in credit. Sentence on the blocked side (Desk Guide: Activation Payment): "quoted only after the prepaid balance of the enrollment carries the carried-in credit for a credit balance that stood on the enrolled service account when the enrollment was taken." Records: account_balance -232.59 (a credit balance), ledger empty (no credit carried). Search with the sentence's words "carried-in credit credit balance" → "Billing Department Statement: Standard-Billing Credit Balances Carried Into PrePay Power" which describes the write: "that credit is carried into the enrollment as one carried-in credit on the prepaid balance… appears on the enrollment's PrePay ledger as a credit adjustment with the reason carried-in standard-billing credit". Marked **state-derived**.
- The carried-in credit documents state no prerequisite of their own → tree ends. Order: carried-in credit, then activation quote/payment (the quote's prepaid-balance term also reads the credited balance).
- Counter-proof "do only what she asked": quoting without the carried-in credit is barred by the sentence above ("while the prepaid balance does not yet carry that carried-in credit, no activation payment is quoted"), and the credit balance of -232.59 is visible; doing only the root would also give 50.00 instead of 102.19.
- Closest alternatives excluded: netting the credit against another account — barred ("never netted against another account's debt"; there is no other account anyway); carrying the whole 232.59 — barred by the worksheet's cut-over reserve and hold; using today's date instead of the enrollment date for reserve days — the worksheet anchors to "the enrollment date"; counting the LIHEAP agency payment 09-25 as "latest" — the 09-29 mailed check is later; counting gt_allocation years — excluded by "Allocations from any other source do not count".
- Interpretive note: windows in factor documents run from "the current date" (10-06), while the credit balance and reserve days anchor at enrollment (10-01); for this record set both readings give the same tiers.
- No other problem's tool name, route or chain appeared in any document read; hop not pre-solved.
